title: A REST API on localhost:3300
intro: Start the API server with `greemo api-server --port 3300`. All responses are JSON and successful responses have `"success": true`.
note: Status codes: 200 Success, 404 Not found, 500 Server error, 503 AI not configured. The JSON schema and tool manifest live in `docs/ai-tools-schema.json`.
examples:
# Start API server
greemo api-server &

# Create site
curl -X POST http://localhost:3300/api/sites \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"shop","title":"My Shop"}'

# List pages
curl "http://localhost:3300/api/pages?sitePath=./sites/shop"
